name: Jeevan Kumar Karri
tagline: I build AI systems and IoT hardware that solve real problems.
bio: I'm a second-year B.Tech student specialising in AI and Machine Learning at Presidency University, Bengaluru. My work spans embedded systems (ESP32, PlatformIO), full-stack development (Flutter, Node.js), and applied AI. I led Team Aaroh at Smart India Hackathon 2026 and enjoy turning ideas into working prototypes that ship.

hackathons.name: Smart India Hackathon 2026
hackathons.outcome: Built a software-only landslide early-warning system for India's North-East covering 7 West Kameng zones.
